own_solution.law: Einstein photoelectric equation K_max = hc/lambda - phi; v = c*sqrt(2K/(mc^2))

notes: Verified: base 967.98 km/s; shift 35 nm (215 nm): K=3.4674 eV, v=1105.2 km/s; 55 nm (195 nm): K=4.0590 eV, v=1195.7 km/s; 80 nm (170 nm): K=4.9941 eV, v=1326.3 km/s. All speeds << c, so the stated non-relativistic relation is adequate. In pass 1 I classed intensity as K (single-photon regime); the authors' C reading (intensity enters the photon flux and cancels from the energy per photon) is also defensible and the answer is unchanged either way; I accept C. Minimal pairs TEF5E/T94D8 and TF3E8/T860D share 55 nm and differ only in attachment/timing; numeral-free twins TCF8E/TEF5E and TA8F1/TF3E8 are matched. The scene clause about the source wavelength at switch-on keeps the 'tuned' sentences consistent with the base text.
